<h2>Resolve Functional-Type Trait Transformations</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Resolves one supported functional-type sensitivity variant to its explicit
named trait-transformation contract.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_functional_type_trait_transformations(trait_variant_id = "all_six")
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="trait_variant_id">trait_variant_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar identifying the sensitivity
variant. Supported values are &quot;all_six&quot;, &quot;without_lma&quot;,
&quot;without_nitrogen&quot;, &quot;without_lma_nitrogen&quot;, and &quot;without_ssd&quot;.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>The primary analysis uses all six traits. Sensitivity variants remove
provisional-unit traits individually or together, or remove stem specific
density to test sensitivity to its source uncertainty.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named character vector of trait transformations.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_functional_type_trait_transformations("all_six")
resolve_functional_type_trait_transformations("without_lma")
</code></pre>

</main>
